title: 14th-century Europe
body: Bloody conflicts sweep the land and the Black Death comes for the survivors. In that moment of weakness, vampires walk out of the shadows to claim the freedom and power they were denied for centuries, and other creatures of the night follow.

title: What a Dawnwalker is
body: Someone forever treading the line between the world of day and the realm of night: human by day, vampire by night.

title: Remnants of an ancient civilisation
body: Forgotten ruins across the valley hold traces of an older civilisation, and truths the official site says “should probably remain hidden”.

title: Coen
body: A young man turned into a Dawnwalker, fighting to save his family. He can fight for his humanity or embrace his cursed powers.

title: Coen’s sire
body: The vampire who turned Coen. One path through the story is swearing revenge on his sire and destroying everyone in the way.

title: Brencis
body: The vampire lord at the centre of the story. Coverage of the game describes Coen’s family being taken for Brencis’s coronation.

title: Others you may meet
body: Update 1.1’s fix list names Anca, Lacra, Bakir, Ambrus, Ocha, Xanthe and the Matriarch, among others. Gamebook has not yet verified who they are, so no descriptions are given.

title: Vale Sangora
body: The valley where the story is set. Lush forests, vast plains, treacherous swamps, steep mountaintops and medieval settlements.

title: Places named in Update 1.1
body: Svartrau, Maragir, Silberstein, the Middens, Uriash Village, Silts Tower and Briar Sloughs Tower all appear in the official fix list. Descriptions will follow once verified.

title: The vampires
body: Long hidden, now ruling openly: they seized the chance the plague gave them and changed history as we know it.

title: Unlikely alliances
body: You can go alone or search for friends and forge unlikely alliances. Which groups those are is not covered here yet.

title: Day and night
body: Two gameplay loops with different abilities, mysteries and ways to reach your goals. By day you fight as a human with sword and magic; by night you defy gravity as a vampire. Each form has strengths and weaknesses.

title: Time moves when you act
body: Your family’s days are numbered. Taking on a quest moves time forward, so choose whom to help: you will not have time for everyone.

title: Ability paths
body: Abilities are grouped into Swordmastery, Witchcraft and Vampirism. Since Update 1.1 you can forget them with the Draught of Mind Rebirth and use that time to learn a different set.

title: Day and night equipment presets
body: Since Update 1.1, the same item can be equipped in both the day and night presets at once.

title: Trying a new build
body: Before you drink the Draught of Mind Rebirth, write your current abilities in My book so you can rebuild them. Where to find the draught is not covered in the official notes.

title: Choosing a difficulty after 1.1
body: If you played on Story before the update, that setting is now called Forgiving. The new Story mode adds additional combat assist.

title: Sold something by mistake?
body: Merchants now offer Buyback, and equipped items are hidden while you sell.

title: Larger subtitles
body: Update 1.1 lets you increase the subtitle font size and show subtitles for all dialogue lines.

title: Controller drift
body: Controller deadzone settings are in Options since Update 1.1.

title: FrameGen crash on AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT
body: Known issue: the game may crash when switching FrameGen from Off to On on an AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT. Rebel Wolves is looking into it.
